# NEW 2026-11-18 third round N3 (cadastre survey). Generated by gen_round3_cadastre.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Any scope. Imperial Authority change, kept within 0..100.
oe_tcd_auth = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } }
# BYZ scope. Third round T3 counter: one event fired by this track's scheduler.
oe_tcd_count = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tcd } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tcd value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tcd add = 1 }
}
# Theme scope. Register quality +/- $amount$, kept within 0..3.
oe_tcd_q_add = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_quality } } set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_quality value = 2 } }
    change_variable = { name = oe_tcd_quality add = $amount$ }
    clamp_variable = { name = oe_tcd_quality min = 0 max = 3 }
}
# Theme scope. Clears the survey (not the cooldown, not the register's results).
oe_tcd_clear = {
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_survey
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_months
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_press
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_quality
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_q_start
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_q_done
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_inc_hide
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_inc_mon
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_inc_flee
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_q_hide
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_q_mon
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_q_flee
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_await
}
# Theme scope. Starts the survey variables (usual press until oe_tcd.1 is answered).
oe_tcd_begin_vars = {
    oe_tcd_clear = yes
    set_variable = oe_tcd_survey
    set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_months value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_press value = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_quality value = 2 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_cd years = 10 }
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_tcd_theme is the province. Contract: starts a survey without cost and asks how hard to press.
oe_tcd_begin = {
    scope:oe_tcd_theme = { oe_tcd_begin_vars = yes set_variable = oe_tcd_q_start }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.1
}
# BYZ scope; scope:oe_tcd_theme set. The action (and the AI): pays and starts.
oe_tcd_send_do = {
    oe_tcd_auth = { amount = -5 }
    add_gold = -100
    oe_tcd_begin = yes
}
# Theme scope. Press: strict.
oe_tcd_press_strict = { set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_press value = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_quality value = 3 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -5 } if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 3 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -6 } } if = { limit = { oe_tg_house_born = yes } oe_ti_house_inf = { amount = -30 } } }
# Theme scope. Press: usual.
oe_tcd_press_usual = { set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_press value = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_quality value = 2 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -2 } if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 3 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -5 } } if = { limit = { oe_tg_house_born = yes } oe_ti_house_inf = { amount = -15 } } }
# Theme scope. Press: light.
oe_tcd_press_light = { set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_press value = 0 } set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_quality value = 1 } if = { limit = { var:oe_theme_fiscal ?= 3 } oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = -3 } } if = { limit = { oe_tg_house_born = yes } oe_ti_house_inf = { amount = -5 } } }
# Theme scope. Incident: 3 more months of work (the monastery's land is registered but stays exempt).
oe_tcd_delay = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tcd_months } change_variable = { name = oe_tcd_months add = -3 } }
}

# Theme scope (from the hidden worker event oe_tcd.9). Enters the new register: var:oe_tcd_final = quality 0..3.
oe_tcd_apply_register = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tcd_final }
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_tcd_final ?= 1 }
            oe_ts_recent_eff = { line = 4 amount = 5 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_trib value = 0.02 years = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_registered value = 1 years = 10 }
            every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q1 remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q2 remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q3 add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q1 years = 10 mode = replace } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_tcd_final ?= 2 }
            oe_ts_recent_eff = { line = 4 amount = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_trib value = 0.03 years = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_registered value = 2 years = 10 }
            every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q1 remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q2 remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q3 add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q2 years = 10 mode = replace } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_tcd_final ?= 3 }
            oe_ts_recent_eff = { line = 4 amount = 15 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_trib value = 0.04 years = 10 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_registered value = 3 years = 10 }
            every_owned_foreign_building_location = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q1 remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q2 remove_location_modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q3 add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_tcd_reg_q3 years = 10 mode = replace } }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = oe_tcd_final
    oe_tcd_clear = yes
}

# Theme scope, monthly (from the BYZ pulse). Counts the months and queues the incidents and the result.
oe_tcd_theme_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_ts_charter = yes }
        oe_tcd_clear = yes   # a chartered city refuses the survey
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_months } } set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_months value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_tcd_months add = 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tcd_months var:oe_tcd_months >= 24 }
            # the result waits for pending incidents; oe_tcd_await stops a second result event while one is open
            if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_tcd_incident_pending = yes } NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_await } } set_variable = oe_tcd_q_done }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_tcd_months var:oe_tcd_months >= 2 NOT = { oe_tcd_incident_pending = yes } oe_tcd_incident_left = yes }
            random = {
                chance = oe_tcd_incident_chance
                random_list = {
                    10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_inc_hide } } set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_hide set_variable = oe_tcd_q_hide }
                    10 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_inc_hide } oe_tg_house_born = yes } set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_hide set_variable = oe_tcd_q_hide }
                    8 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_inc_mon } } set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_mon set_variable = oe_tcd_q_mon }
                    16 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_inc_mon } OR = { var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 8 var:oe_theme_region_id ?= 9 } } set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_mon set_variable = oe_tcd_q_mon }
                    8 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_inc_flee } NOT = { var:oe_tcd_press ?= 0 } } set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_flee set_variable = oe_tcd_q_flee }
                    8 = { trigger = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_inc_flee } NOT = { var:oe_tcd_press ?= 0 } var:oe_tcd_press ?= 2 } set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_flee set_variable = oe_tcd_q_flee }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
# Theme scope, monthly. Extra tribute of a new register, when the province can pay it in full.
oe_tcd_tribute = {
    save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_tcd_trib_amt value = oe_tcd_tribute_amount }
    if = {
        limit = { scope:oe_tcd_trib_amt > 0 gold >= scope:oe_tcd_trib_amt }
        add_gold = { value = scope:oe_tcd_trib_amt multiply = -1 }
        c:BYZ = { add_gold = scope:oe_tcd_trib_amt }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly (on_action oe_tcd_byz_pulse).
oe_tcd_byz_monthly = {
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_tcd_survey } oe_tcd_theme_monthly = yes }
    # extra tribute of a new register (exarchates and despotates)
    every_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_variable = oe_tcd_trib } oe_tcd_tribute = yes }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 is_ai = yes } oe_tcd_ai_yearly = yes }
    oe_tcd_dispatch = yes
}
# BYZ scope. At most one event of this track a month; incidents before the result.
oe_tcd_dispatch = {
    if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tcd_q_hide } } oe_tcd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.2 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tcd_q_mon } } oe_tcd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.3 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tcd_q_flee } } oe_tcd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.5 }
    else_if = { limit = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tcd_q_done } } oe_tcd_count = yes trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.4 }
}
# BYZ scope, every January when Byzantium is AI. Rarely, with spare authority and gold, one survey at a time.
oe_tcd_ai_yearly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            oe_tcd_can_send = yes
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority var:oe_pillars_authority >= 25 }
            gold >= 400
            NOT = { any_subject = { has_variable = oe_tcd_survey } }
            any_subject = { oe_tcd_ai_target = yes }
        }
        random = {
            chance = 15
            oe_tcd_ai_start = yes
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. The AI picks a loyal province and sends the apographeus.
oe_tcd_ai_start = {
    random_subject = { limit = { oe_tcd_ai_target = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tcd_theme }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tcd_theme } oe_tcd_count = yes oe_tcd_send_do = yes }
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- test helpers (dev mod buttons and console)
# BYZ scope. The province under test: var oe_tcd_test_theme (the dev mod copies var:oe_dev_t into it), else a random one.
oe_tcd_test_pick = {
    if = {
        limit = { var:oe_tcd_test_theme ?= { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        var:oe_tcd_test_theme = { save_scope_as = oe_tcd_tt }
    }
    else = {
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes NOT = { oe_ts_charter = yes } } save_scope_as = oe_tcd_tt }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tcd_tt } set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_test_theme value = scope:oe_tcd_tt } }
    }
}
# Start a survey on the test province without cost or cooldown (opens oe_tcd.1).
oe_tcd_test_start = {
    oe_tcd_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_tcd_tt ?= { remove_variable = oe_tcd_cd save_scope_as = oe_tcd_theme }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tcd_theme } oe_tcd_begin = yes }
}
# The test province's survey is under way (started silently if needed).
oe_tcd_test_ensure = {
    oe_tcd_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_tcd_tt ?= { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_tcd_survey } } oe_tcd_begin_vars = yes } }
}
# Finish the test province's survey now: the result event oe_tcd.4 fires at once.
oe_tcd_test_finish = {
    oe_tcd_test_ensure = yes
    scope:oe_tcd_tt ?= {
        set_variable = { name = oe_tcd_months value = 24 }
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_q_hide
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_q_mon
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_q_flee
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_await
        set_variable = oe_tcd_q_done
    }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.4
}
oe_tcd_test_ev2 = { oe_tcd_test_ensure = yes scope:oe_tcd_tt ?= { set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_hide set_variable = oe_tcd_q_hide } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.2 }
oe_tcd_test_ev3 = { oe_tcd_test_ensure = yes scope:oe_tcd_tt ?= { set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_mon set_variable = oe_tcd_q_mon } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.3 }
oe_tcd_test_ev5 = { oe_tcd_test_ensure = yes scope:oe_tcd_tt ?= { set_variable = oe_tcd_inc_flee set_variable = oe_tcd_q_flee } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tcd.5 }
# The AI path once, without the yearly chance (still needs authority, gold and a loyal province).
oe_tcd_test_ai = {
    if = { limit = { oe_tcd_can_send = yes any_subject = { oe_tcd_ai_target = yes } } oe_tcd_ai_start = yes }
}
# Clear the test province's survey, cooldown and register (location modifiers stay until they expire).
oe_tcd_test_reset = {
    oe_tcd_test_pick = yes
    scope:oe_tcd_tt ?= {
        oe_tcd_clear = yes
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_cd
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_trib
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_registered
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_final
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_job_reg
        remove_variable = oe_tcd_job_unrest
    }
}
